milestone.describes: The game is being played: the stick figure hangs from a rope over the pillars, tapping drops him, the level counter advances (A-1 onward) and lives are lost on a miss.

steps.expect: The title screen with three unlabelled menu bars down the right.
Level A-1: the stick figure hanging from a rope over the pillars, with the level counter and three hearts.
The character drops and swings. Either he lands and the level advances, or he misses and a heart is lost.
A second drop. Across these two taps the level counter moved A-1 -> A-4 and the hearts fell from three to one when this was recorded — levels advance and failure is scored, which is the milestone.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 480x320 landscape window.
The menu buttons draw with no labels on them, so step 1 is 'the topmost of the three bars' rather than a named button. Do not go looking for text that is not there.

How far the level counter moves depends on whether each drop lands, so the exact A-1 -> A-4 in the recording is not something to expect again. What must happen is that taps make the character drop and the counters change.
